name: Mahou Shoujo Lyiene -Inma no Shirenjou-
original_name: 魔法少女リィ －淫魔の試練場－
source:
There is a dungeon located on a small island called "Vanaheim".
This dungeon is rumoured to be the location where the legendary Witch "Alice" bequeathed a legacy upon her death, because of this many adventurers have travelled to this dungeon seeking Alice's Legacy.
However, the dungeon is infested with dangerous monsters and traps, to this day not a single adventurer has laid eyes on the Legacy.
The Mahou Shoujo (Magical Girl) Lyiene is another who has come to the island having heard the rumours about Vanaheim island.
The adventure of Mahou Shoujo Lyiene, who seeks to uncover the truth of the legendary witch's legacy which sleeps within the dungeon, begins now.

[Translated from product page]
translation:
在一座名为瓦纳海姆的小岛上，有一座地下城。

传闻传说中的女巫“爱丽丝”死前将遗产留在了这座地下城里，因此许多冒险者前往那里寻找爱丽丝的遗产。

然而，地下城中遍布危险的怪物和陷阱，直到今天还没有任何冒险者亲眼见过遗产。

魔法少女莉艾涅听到瓦纳海姆岛的传闻后，也来到了这座岛。

寻找沉睡在地下城中的传奇女巫遗产真相的魔法少女莉艾涅，就此踏上冒险。

[译自商品页面]
